title: TABULAR STATEMENT No. 2. SHOWING the Condition of the various Indian Schools in the Dominion (from which Returns have been received) for the Year ended 30th June, 1889.
columns: Reserve on which situated and Fund from which Paid.

label: Pic River
values: Pic River, Lake Superior. Methodist Missionery Society
Catechism taught.

label: Port Arthur, Roman Catholic
values: At Port Arthur. Is paid $12 per annum (per capita) from Indian School Fund
Catechism taught.

label: Port Elgin
values: Nawash, County of Bruce. Paid by Band

label: Rama
values: Rama, County of Ontario. Indian School fund
See Remarks opposite and Alnwick.

label: Red Line
values: Six Nation, County of Brant. Indian School Fund and Methodist Missionary Society
See Remarks opposite Alnwick.

label: Red Rock
values: Red Rock or Helen Island, about 70 miles from Port Arthur. Indian School Fund

label: Ryerson
values: Parry Island, Parry Sound District. Band and Indian School Fund

label: Sagamook
values: Spanish River. Indian School Fund

label: Saugeen
values: Saugeen, County of Bruce. Indian School Fund
See Remarks opposite and Alnwick.

label: Scotch Settlement
values: Saugeen, County of Bruce. Paid by Chippewas of Saugeen

label: Serpent River
values: Serpent River, north shore of Lake huron. Indian School Fund

label: Shawanaga
values: Shawanaga, Parry Sound District. Indian School Fund and Band

label: Sheguiandah
values: Sheguiandah, Ojibbewas and Ottawas of Manitoulin Island

label: Shingwauk Home
values: Garden River, District of Algoma. See Remarks
An Industrial School; all pupils resident; $60 per annum for each of 30 pupils, contributed from Indian Funds. The boys learn farming, trades, & c.

label: Sidney Bay
values: Nawash, County of Bruce. Paid by Band.

label: Six Nations, No. 2
values: Six Nation, Co. of Brant. See Remarks

Object lessons taught. The salaries of the teachers of these 9 schools are paid from special grants from the Indian School Fund, the funds of the Six Nations and the New England Co., respectively; the first named contributing $400, the second $1,500 and the third $1,000 per annum for that purpose.
